title: Basic derivative rules
intro: Read this before the first differentiation questions.

blocks.title: linearity
blocks.body: Differentiate term by term, and constants multiply through: $\dfrac{d}{dx}(af+bg)=af'+bg'$. The derivative of a constant is $0$.
Rewrite roots and reciprocals as powers first: $\dfrac1x=x^{-1}$, $\sqrt x=x^{1/2}$.

blocks.title: the slips
items: The derivative of $\cos x$ is $-\sin x$, with the minus.
